sn52.2:1.2: Atha kho āyasmato Anuruddhassa rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn52.2:1.3: Yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā viraddhā viraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī || ||
sn52.2:1.4: Yesaṃ kesañci cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā āraddho tesam ariyo maggo sammādukkhakkhayagāmī ti || || 3.
sn52.2:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno āyasmato Anuruddhassa cetasā ceto parivitakkam aññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso || pe || || Evam eva āyasmato Anuruddhassa pamukhe pātur ahosi || || 4. Atha kho āyasmā Mahā-Moggalāno āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avoca || ||
sn52.2:3.1: Kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Anuruddha bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā honti || || 5.
sn52.2:4.1: Idhāvuso bhikkhu ajjhattaṃ kāye kāyānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn52.2:4.2: Bahiddhā kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī || la-pe ||
sn52.2:4.3: Ajjhattabahiddhā kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī || abhijjhadomanassam || || 6.
sn52.2:5.3: Ajjhattam bahiddhā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 7.
sn52.2:6.3: ajjhattabahiddhā citte cittānupassī viharati || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 8.
sn52.2:7.3: ajjhattabahiddhādhammesu dhammānupassī viharati: ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || || 9.
sn52.2:7.4: Ettāvatā kho āvuso bhikkhuno cattāro satipaṭṭhānā āraddhā hontī
